title: Neural SR overfit experiment
description: Run the first end-to-end training experiment: overfit one expression to verify the model, data pipeline, and tracking work correctly together.

title: Wire jernerics tracking into symlab
description: Add jernerics as a path dependency to symlab. Start the tracking server. Verify the trial function can import both manifest and jernerics.tracking.
close_reason: Jernerics + jernerics-server added as editable path deps. Tracking server running on localhost:8000. [tool.jernerics] config added to pyproject.toml.

title: Write overfit experiment trial + config
description: Create experiments/overfit/trial.py and config.py. The trial generates one fixed expression, runs ~200 training steps on a tiny model, logs loss/metrics via tracker. Config has no search space (single trial).
close_reason: Written experiments/overfit/trial.py and config.py. Single expression (mul(add(x0,2.5),x1)), tiny model (d_model=64), 200 steps, logs loss/grad_norm/lr to tracker.

title: Run and debug overfit experiment
description: Run via jernerics local runner. Fix import errors, env issues, shape mismatches. Verify loss approaches 0.
close_reason: Overfit experiment ran successfully. Loss 9.74 -> 0.032 in 200 steps. All params, metrics, and model artifact tracked to server. Tracking works end-to-end.

title: HPC connectivity + observability notes
description: Set up SSH reverse tunnel for HPC tracking server access. Verify HPC can reach the server. Document observability gaps discovered during the run.
